issue_A.title: ValuesManager internal isDirty never triggers parent isDirty

evidence.ValuesManager_internal_isDirty: line 689: local isDirty calculated from isNew/isDeleted/originalValue
evidence.ValuesTab_handleValuesChange: AttributeDetailPanel.tsx line 185-191: calls onChange({...formData, allowed_values, synonyms})

issue_A.conclusion: The chain IS wired correctly: ValuesManager.onChange -> handleValuesChange -> onFormChange -> setIsDirty(true). The parent isDirty SHOULD become true when values are edited.

issue_B.title: ValuesManager 'Save Values' button has no onSave prop

evidence.onSave_not_passed: ValuesTab does NOT pass onSave prop

issue_B.conclusion: The 'Save Values' button calls handleSave which returns early because onSave is undefined. This is a confirmed bug.
issue_B.impact: MEDIUM - Users cannot use the 'Save Values' button in ValuesManager, but they CAN use the parent Save button in AttributeHeader which DOES work.

issue_C.title: AttributeHeader Save button disabled when isDirty=false
issue_C.conclusion: This is correct behavior - Save should be disabled when no changes.

issue_D.title: ValuesManager initialValues computed with useMemo + Date.now()

evidence.useMemo_deps: AttributeDetailPanel.tsx line 169-182: useMemo depends on [formData.allowed_values, formData.synonyms]
evidence.originalValue_not_set: initialValues do not set originalValue, so isDirty in ValuesManager will be wrong

issue_D.conclusion: When formData changes, initialValues regenerates with new Date.now() IDs but no originalValue. This may cause ValuesManager's internal isDirty to be incorrect (always false for existing values).

onFormChange prop is passed from AttributeDetailPanel
Save button in AttributeHeader enables when isDirty=true
